title: Lease Structural Record
description: Structural Lease graph node. Counterparties, customer relationships, lease type, capacity, dates, terms, and financial values belong exclusively in Facts.

id.description: Stable UUID used as the Lease graph node and Fact relationship target.

schema_version.description: Version of this structural Lease contract.

entity_type.description: Fixed collection discriminator used for deterministic typed references.

slug.description: Stable repository key; it is not an evidentiary contract name.

display_name.description: Non-authoritative interface label for navigation; never a sourced lease title.

campus_id.description: Optional structural containment edge to a Campus node; lease applicability and counterparties remain Facts.

project_id.description: Optional structural containment edge to a Project node; lease applicability and counterparties remain Facts.

created_at.description: UTC date-time when this structural graph node was created.

modified_at.description: UTC date-time of the latest permitted repository-administration update.

record_status.description: Repository-management state, not the commercial status of the Lease.

administrative_notes.description: Optional repository-management note containing no asserted contract facts.
